title: Biomineralisation
description: Some bacteria grow chains of magnetite crystals and steer by the Earth's field. Kept short of air, they mine iron for you. Unlocks bacterial Magnetite.

puzzle.goal: A chain of n magnetite crystals, each of moment m, lines up in a field B against the jostling of heat, kT. Write the share A it lines up by, for a weak field, m·n·B over three kT.
puzzle.name: Langevin alignment
puzzle.ask: Find A for m = @{m}, n = @{n}, B = @{B}, k = @{k} and T = @{T}.
puzzle.method: For a small field the Langevin function is about x/3, with x = mnB/kT: a longer chain steers better.
